disqualifier.note: Distinct named owner extending AcpProtocolLoggingOptions. Inherited optional logIncoming/logOutgoing remain independently selected; makeAcpPatchedProtocol reads each with a separate === true guard at :503-504, and logger falls back to Effect.logDebug at :501 so logger presence is not an E3 payload of either toggle.

Distinct named client constructor options extending AcpProtocolLoggingOptions. make independently forwards both flags through O.getSomesStruct at :477-478; documented example sets only logOutgoing. Combined-true remains legal because protocol reads are independent.

Distinct named owner extending AcpClientOptions; handle is a process runtime, not a Boolean. layerChildProcess spreads remaining options into make at :712-715; documented constructor sets only logOutgoing. Incoming and outgoing stay independently optional.

Distinct named agent constructor options extending AcpProtocolLoggingOptions. make independently forwards both flags through O.getSomesStruct at :322-323; documented example sets only logIncoming. No exclusive-write or exclusive-read of the pair.

Distinct named owner extending AcpAgentOptions; stdio is transport, not a Boolean. layer destructures stdio and forwards remaining options to make at :605-606; documented constructor sets only logIncoming. Incoming and outgoing remain independently optional.
